_meta.description: Upgrade card library for the Legion app, organized by upgrade slot category (the icon shown in a unit's upgrade bar).
_meta.verification_status: PRIMARY-SOURCE EXPANSION PASS 1 COMPLETE (2026-08-24). Current universal/generic coverage expanded from the 29-card seed to 95 entries. The current AMG Generic Upgrade Cards PDF (April 2026) and New Universal Upgrades PDF (April 2026) were audited card-by-card, with June 17 2026 Errata/points overrides applied where identified. Existing neutral cards explicitly removed from current standard play were NOT deleted: they are retained for the app custom/legacy mode and marked in notes. Hunter is retained as legacy/ambiguous because it is absent from the current Generic PDF but is not named on the June 2026 removed-card list. COVERAGE STILL INCOMPLETE: faction-specific Galactic Empire, Galactic Republic, Rebel Alliance, Separatist Alliance, Mercenary, Mandalorian, and the rest of the legacy/removed upgrade pool still require separate passes. No new fields or categories were added. GALACTIC EMPIRE EXPANSION PASS 2A COMPLETE (2026-08-24): 5 current heavy-weapon upgrades from the April 2026 AMG Galactic Empire Upgrade Cards PDF (DLT-19 Stormtrooper, T-21 Stormtrooper, RT-97C Stormtrooper, HH-12 Stormtrooper, and Flametrooper) were added after one bounded June 17 2026 errata check. Total library size is now 100 entries.

upgrades.name: Aggressive Tactics

upgrades.notes: Effect sourced 2026-08-23 via web search (community sources, not a single primary quote). Points cost conflicting across sources (10 vs 15) -- left unverified rather than guessing which is current. RETIRED FROM CURRENT STANDARD PLAY (AMG Errata Reference, effective 2026-06-17). Retained intentionally for custom/legacy mode.

upgrades.name: Force Reflexes
upgrades.effect_description: Exhaustible card. Gain 1 dodge token as a free action.

Points cost appears to be CHARACTER-VARIABLE rather than flat (one source cites 15 points on Darth Vader vs 5 points on Luke Skywalker) -- this app's schema models one flat `points` value per upgrade, so left unverified/null rather than picking one character's cost as if universal. Worth a schema note for future unit-specific-pricing support.

upgrades.name: Saber Throw

upgrades.source: AMG Generic Upgrade Cards (April 2026), with April/June 2026 points update
upgrades.notes: Current tournament cost is 10 points. AMG April 2026 Development Update increased it from the printed 5.

upgrades.name: Extra Supplies

upgrades.name: Kraken
upgrades.effect_description: Add a Kraken miniature. The unit loses AI, gains another Heavy Weapon slot, and when attacking may upgrade 1 attack die for each miniature from the unit that was previously defeated.

upgrades.name: Agent Kallus

upgrades.effect_description: Add Agent Kallus and increase the unit's Courage by 1. The unit gains Demoralize 1 and another Heavy Weapon slot; as a free action, choose an engaged enemy unit and give it 2 immobilize tokens.

upgrades.name: Clone Captain Rex

upgrades.notes: Eligible rank/type icons were not expanded beyond the official printed restriction.
